title: The Crowded bus at the stop
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：crowded　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 crowded 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the grandmother wrote of ① a crowded bus at the stop in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② more crowded than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the crowded ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most crowded bus at the stop anybody in the courtyard had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too crowded to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the crowded ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a crowded week before the fair, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as crowded as the week before the fair they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was crowded or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something crowded, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite crowded; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the crowded ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, at once, she wrote of another crowded bus at the stop in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more crowded than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most crowded week before the fair in the whole courtyard, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the crowded ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 拥挤（前置定语 a crowded bus at the stop：1988 年祖母在日记里记下的那件拥挤的公交车）
B. adj. 拥挤／人满为患（比较级 more crowded than：文中两处，一处比站上的公交车，一处比预想）
C. adj. 拥挤／人满为患（最高级 the most crowded：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 拥挤（表语 too crowded to do：母亲觉得它太拥挤，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 人满为患（前置定语 a crowded week before the fair：叔叔把整件事称作一桩人满为患的那一周）
F. adj. 人满为患（同级比较 as crowded as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩集市前的那一周相比）
G. adj. 人满为患（后置定语 something crowded：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 人满为患（受程度副词修饰 quite crowded：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a crowded bus at the stop
the most crowded bus at the stop anybody
a crowded week before the fair
The most crowded week before the fair in

answers.why: crowded 意为“拥挤”，1988 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件拥挤的公交车”，此处作前置定语 a crowded bus at the stop。
crowded 意为“拥挤”，此处用比较级 more crowded than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
crowded 意为“拥挤”，日记上 二月 那行字说它是院子里最拥挤的一件，故用最高级 the most crowded bus at the stop。
crowded 意为“拥挤”，母亲认为这件东西“太拥挤了，谁也用不上”，too crowded to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
crowded 意为“人满为患”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩人满为患的那一周”，此处作前置定语 a crowded week before the fair。
crowded 意为“人满为患”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩集市前的那一周一样人满为患”，同级比较用 as crowded as。
crowded 意为“人满为患”，日记上那半行字要的是“人满为患的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something crowded。
crowded 意为“人满为患”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当人满为患”，quite 修饰原级 crowded。
crowded 意为“人满为患”，1998 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要人满为患”，故用比较级 more crowded than。
crowded 意为“人满为患”，母亲 2000 年说的是“整个院子里最人满为患的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most crowded week before the fair。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件拥挤的公交车。（a crowded bus at the stop）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更拥挤。（more crowded than …）
母亲觉得它太拥挤，谁也用不上。（too crowded to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩人满为患的那一周。（a crowded week before the fair）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩集市前的那一周一样人满为患。（as crowded as …）
到了 1995 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件人满为患的东西。（something crowded）
answers: In 1988 the grandmother wrote of a crowded bus at the stop in the diary.
Everybody said it was more crowded than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too crowded to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a crowded week before the fair.
He said nobody would call it as crowded as the week before the fair they had once had.
By 1995 the diary asked for nothing but something crowded.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 crowded 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the grandmother wrote of a crowded bus at the stop in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most crowded bus at the stop in the courtyard, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too crowded to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a crowded week before the fair, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite crowded, and everybody laughed.
The crowded ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
